column3: Enter EMS critical section: lazily run emsm_init, then save the page map of the descriptor handle (EMS 47h); *saved=1 on success
Map logical page n of the descriptor handle (g_ems_desc_handle) into physical page p (EMS 50h, one pair)
Leave EMS critical section: restore the saved page map (EMS 48h); returns the incoming error if non-zero
Validate a block handle: error 0xD0 if manager not initialised, handle==0xFFFF or beyond the descriptor table
Detect EMM (EMMXXXX0), require >=2 free pages, allocate data and descriptor handles, locate the page frame, init one page of 0x492 free descriptors, count contiguous physical pages
Grow the descriptor handle by one 16K page (EMS 51h) and mark its 0x492 descriptors free; 0xD2 if the table would exceed 64K entries
Allocate ceil(size/16K) new data pages (EMS 51h realloc) for descriptor d; a trailing partial page becomes a free-fragment descriptor
Satisfy an allocation from an existing free fragment descriptor, taking over its pages and splitting off the remainder (?)
Advance g_emsm_first_free (F080) to the next descriptor whose id is 0xFFFF
Create a new free-fragment descriptor for the unused tail of a page after an allocation; updates the high-water mark
Best-fit search over descriptors for a free fragment/empty slot able to hold n bytes; returns slot index and waste
Set *flag=1 if every descriptor in the table is free (used to tear down EMS when the last block is freed)
Merge two adjacent free fragments if their pages fit in 4 (saves/restores the whole page map with EMS 4E00h/4E01h)
Find the free fragment that precedes a freed block and merge it (?)
Find the free fragment that follows a freed block and merge it (?)
Compute free EMS bytes: unallocated pages (EMS 42h) * 16K plus the sizes of free-fragment descriptors
Return the byte size stored in a block's descriptor (error 0xD0 if the handle does not match)
Allocate an EMS block of n bytes (0<n<=64K): find slot, allocate pages or reuse a fragment, stamp descriptor {id=index,size=n}; returns the handle
Free a block: mark descriptor free, lower the free hint, tear everything down if all blocks are free, else coalesce neighbouring fragments
Map up to N blocks at once: pick a run of free physical pages per block, build the logical/physical pair table (DS:461C) and issue EMS 50h; returns far ptrs
Map one block (emsm_map_blocks with count 1) and return its far pointer
Unmap all physical pages, deallocate descriptor and data handles (EMS 45h), clear the initialised flag and free cached near buffers
